parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and compartments of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components like shelves and doors in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and the stored items, ensuring stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is another horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not meant to move during regular use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF, attached to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF, attached to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s left compartment and protects contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
